message: htmlFor isn’t an attribute of <label>. In HTML, htmlFor is written for.
className isn’t an attribute of <label>. In HTML, className is written class.
<input type="text" id="name"> has no label. Add <label for="…">…</label> or wrap it in a label (WCAG 1.3.1, 4.1.2).
defaultValue isn’t an attribute of <input>. In HTML, defaultValue is written value.
